description: Unit tests for channel activity tracking functions, testing recording, retrieval, and resetting of activity timestamps per channel and account.

methods.name: getChannelActivity
methods.description: Retrieves the latest inbound and outbound timestamps for a specified channel and optional account ID.

methods.name: recordChannelActivity
methods.description: Records an activity timestamp for a specific channel, direction, and account ID.

methods.name: resetChannelActivityForTest
methods.description: Resets the activity data, typically used for test setup.
